+@pytest.mark.parametrize("max_connections", [1, 2])
+async def test_connection_pool_replaces_idle_connection_at_limit(max_connections):
+    network_backend = httpcore.AsyncMockBackend(
+        [b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n"]
+    )
+    async with httpcore.AsyncConnectionPool(
+        max_connections=max_connections, network_backend=network_backend
+    ) as pool:
+        for index in range(max_connections):
+            await pool.request("GET", f"https://{index}.example.com/")
+        original_connections = pool.connections
+
+        async with pool.stream("GET", "https://new.example.com/") as response:
+            assert response.status == 200
+            assert len(pool.connections) == max_connections
+            assert original_connections[0].is_closed()
+            assert original_connections[0] not in pool.connections
+            assert pool.connections[:-1] == original_connections[1:]
+            await response.aread()
+
+        assert len(pool.connections) == max_connections
+
